mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.difficulty, p.status, p.submit_count, p.accepted_count, p.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, p.created_at

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM problem_tags pt WHERE pt.problem_id = p.id AND pt.tag_id = #{tagId})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problems (title, difficulty, description, input_format, output_format, hint, source, time_limit_ms, memory_limit_mb, author_id, status, submit_count, accepted_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{difficulty}, #{description}, #{inputFormat}, #{outputFormat}, #{hint}, #{source}, #{timeLimitMs}, #{memoryLimitMb}, #{authorId}, #{status}, #{submitCount}, #{acceptedCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE problems SET title = #{title}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, description = #{description}, input_format = #{inputFormat}, output_format = #{outputFormat}, hint = #{hint}, source = #{source}, time_limit_ms = #{timeLimitMs}, memory_limit_mb = #{memoryLimitMb}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, difficulty, description, input_format, output_format, hint, source, time_limit_ms, memory_limit_mb, author_id, status, submit_count, accepted_count, created_at, updated_at FROM problems WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT FROM problems p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE problems SET submit_count = submit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE problems SET accepted_count = accepted_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE problems SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
